test_title: PYST 15: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

Despite having a lot of work to do, he spent the whole day engaging in **__frivolous__** activities like playing video games and watching TV.
solution: The correct answer is **"worthless."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Frivolous"** means lacking in seriousness or importance. (अगंभीर; मूर्खतापूर्ण) • **Example**:* I feel like doing something completely **frivolous**__ today.* • **"Worthless"** is a synonym of **"frivolous."** • **"Worthless" **means having no value or use. (बेकार, किसी काम (या दाम) का नहीं, व्‍यर्थ का) __ • **Example**: *It’s** worthless**__—it’s only a bit of plastic!* • The sentence implies that the activities he engaged in were not productive and had no value. • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, mischievous**, means causing or showing a fondness for causing trouble in a playful way. ((प्रायः बच्‍चों के लिए प्रयुक्त) शरारती, नटखट) • **Option 2, detestable**, means deserving intense dislike. (घृणित; निंदनीय; घृणास्पद) • **Option 3, secretive**, means inclined to conceal feelings and intentions or not to disclose information. (बातों को दूसरों से छिपाने के स्‍वभाव वाला; गोपनशील, गोपनप्रिय) 41:Tbbc, The correct answer is **"Resilient."**
